mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user) AS total_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doctor) AS total_doctors, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment a INNER JOIN source s ON s.id = a.source_id WHERE s.visit_date = CURRENT_DATE AND a.status != '取消') AS today_appointments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment a INNER JOIN source s ON s.id = a.source_id WHERE s.visit_date = CURRENT_DATE AND a.status = '已完成') AS today_completed, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refund WHERE status = '退款申请') AS pending_refund_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doctor WHERE status = '待审核') AS pending_audit_doctor_count
